findings.passage: For example, while some legislators want to do away with gun safety laws altogether, we believe it is time to modernize, not repeal, Wisconsin’s decade-old concealed carry permit system.
findings.note: Op-ed co-written with another Assembly member. Says the carry permit system should be updated, not repealed.

findings.passage: To achieve this, we need a regulatory framework that prioritizes safe storage, robust background checks on every gun sale, and the ability to temporarily remove guns from people in crisis or who threaten to harm others.
findings.note: Same op-ed (co-written). Calls for safe storage rules, background checks on every sale, and temporary removal of guns from people in crisis.

findings.passage: Assembly Bill 484 requires – for the first time – live-fire training in order to carry a concealed weapon, increases awareness of the risk of gun suicides, and provides more robust safety training so that those who choose to carry a gun in public do so safely.
findings.note: Same op-ed (co-written). Describes AB 484 (2025 session), which adds live-fire training for a carry permit.

findings.passage: We believe in, and responsible gun owners support, data-driven firearm safety policies and Republicans should, too.
findings.note: Same op-ed (co-written). General statement for firearm safety policy.

findings.passage: This bill package my Democratic colleagues and I are introducing today will keep our friends, families, and communities safe through common-sense measures that would make it harder for dangerous people to get guns and easier for families to keep their loved ones safe.
findings.note: Official press release statement on the 'Safe Summer' gun safety bill package introduced 2025-06-03.
subjects: limits on who may have a gun

findings.passage: As a long-time gun safety advocate, I look forward to working with the Governor and my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to ensure these vital safety measures become law this session.
findings.note: Same release. Describes herself as a gun safety advocate and backs the package.
